images.title: One term times each of three
images.purpose: Shows 3a/2 multiplying each of the three terms a, − b and + 1/5 in turn, giving three unlike terms.
images.composition: One multiplier on the left with three arrows fanning out to three term cards, and each result under its card. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: On the left, a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded card with the label '3a/2'. To its right, three teal (#0072B2) rounded cards in a row with the labels 'a', '− b' and '+ 1/5'. Three curved arrows go from the '3a/2' card, one to each of the three teal cards. Directly under each teal card, a short down arrow to an amber (#E69F00) result card: '(3/2)a²' under 'a', '− (3/2)ab' under '− b' and '+ (3/10)a' under '+ 1/5'. Centred below the three result cards, the small label 'no like terms'. Exactly 1 multiplier card, 3 term cards, 3 result cards and 6 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Multiply the outside term by every term inside, then add only like terms.

image_decisions.why: The three arrows show that the multiplier reaches every term, the step students skip with longer brackets.
